name: Tablet Toggle
author: ngek202
description: Tablet-mode toggle bar-widget for convertible laptops. Left-click toggles tablet mode; right-click runs an interactive health check (repair only if problems are found). If the companion package is missing, either click installs it visibly (pinned, idempotent). After install: SUPER+B = on-screen keyboard (SAM OSK) · SUPER+SHIFT+T = tablet mode · 3-finger swipes = pages and tablet exit. Companion to the tablet-kbd package.

barWidget.description: Tablet mode on/off for convertible (taps tablet-mode.sh, polls its status)
